name: webtoapp.design
description_en:
webtoapp.design converts an existing website into Android and iOS wrapper apps with native presentation and optional features such as push notifications. The website remains the content/application source inside a built-in browser; the service prepares app builds and guides app-store submission. It is not evidence that every browser feature works unchanged in a WebView.

The owner configures a website URL, branding and app options, tests a preview and completes developer-account/store steps. The current pricing is subscription-based, and the published terms say cancellation deactivates the app. This profile distinguishes web content updates, native binary updates, device-based usage and the unresolved refund wording.
description_zh:
webtoapp.design 将现有网站转换为 Android／iOS 外壳应用，提供原生外观及推送等可选功能。网站仍是在内置浏览器呈现的内容／应用来源，服务负责准备构建并指导商店提交；不能据此认定所有浏览器功能在 WebView 中原样可用。

所有者配置网站 URL、品牌及应用选项，测试预览，完成开发者账户／商店步骤。当前采用订阅计费，已公布条款称取消会停用应用。本文区分网页内容更新、原生二进制更新、按设备用量及未一致的退款表述。

core_features.explanation_en: Display the existing site inside a branded mobile wrapper.
core_features.explanation_zh: 在有品牌外观的移动外壳中显示原网站。

core_features.explanation_en: Separate immediate web/live settings from changes requiring store review.
core_features.explanation_zh: 区分即时网页／在线设置与需商店审核的改动。

core_features.explanation_en: Map website users to current app-instance tokens for notifications.
core_features.explanation_zh: 将网站用户映射至当前应用实例 token 以推送。

core_features.explanation_en: Handle browser-only flows with a separate browser context and close events.
core_features.explanation_zh: 通过独立浏览器上下文及关闭事件处理仅浏览器可用流程。

en: Evaluate wrapping an existing member portal for Android/iOS
Test login handoff, update requirements and device-targeted push
zh: 评估将现有会员门户封装到 Android／iOS
测试登录返回、更新要求及按设备定向推送

steps.zh: 确认网站权利，在两种移动外壳测试核心流程。

steps.zh: 核对自定义标签页登录及推送 token 生命周期。

steps.zh: 确认设备计数、取消／退款条款及签名 key 退出方案。

sources.title: Terms and Conditions for webtoapp.design
sources.research_notes_en: Published Jan2024 terms read: website rights, compiled app/no source transfer, subscription cancellation deactivation, rejection refund condition, server/config dependency and signing-key retention responsibility. Conflicts with homepage guarantee retained.

review_notes: Original AI research draft based on the cited public official pages; no publication, price approval, independent review or product test is implied.
Earlier third-party feature and price claims are retained only in discovery provenance, not as current product evidence.

sections.title_en: Start from a website you can test and publish
sections.title_zh: 从可测试并有权发布的网站开始
sections.en: The homepage flow configures the app, previews it, starts a 14-day paid-plan trial and follows guided store submission. Store employees still review the result. The terms require rights to the website, and pricing says the owner supplies app-store developer accounts. A proposed member portal evaluation should test login, navigation, uploads and payments on both platforms before submission. No app, trial or account was created; published timing and conversion anecdotes are not measured outcomes.
sections.zh: 首页流程为配置应用、预览、开始付费方案十四天试用，再按指导提交商店；最终仍由商店人员审核。条款要求拥有网站使用权，定价说明所有者需提供商店开发者账户。建议会员门户在提交前于两平台测试登录、导航、上传及支付。本次未创建应用、试用或账户，发布时长及转化故事不是实测结果。

sections.title_en: Live website changes are not native binary updates
sections.title_zh: 网页即时变化不等于原生二进制更新
sections.en: The update guide separates three paths. Website content appears without a new binary; selected dashboard changes such as menu items can apply live; changes to app name/icon, startup URL, layout or core code require a store update. Check the installed app and dashboard’s update-required message. Current subscriptions include updates, while legacy lifetime/one-time users may pay per platform/store. Immediate website synchronization therefore does not mean the native wrapper never needs maintenance or another store review.
sections.zh: 更新指南分三路：网页内容无需新二进制即可显示；菜单等部分后台设置可在线生效；应用名／图标、启动 URL、布局及核心代码需商店更新。应检查已安装应用及后台需更新提示。当前订阅含更新，旧终身／一次付费用户可能按平台／商店另付费。因此网站即时同步不代表原生外壳无需维护或再次审核。

sections.title_en: A website account can have several changing device tokens
sections.title_zh: 网站账户可对应多个会变化的设备 token
sections.en: The targeted-push guide calls getNotificationToken after the app is ready, stores the app-instance token against the website user, then uses the API to address that token. Reinstallation, cleared data or another device can change it; multi-device users need multiple tokens. The function can fail for connection/native-bridge problems or a plan without notifications, and regular browser visits do not provide the app bridge. Keep tokens secret and test missing/expired-token behavior. No token, notification or API key was generated.
sections.zh: 定向推送指南在应用就绪后调用 getNotificationToken，将应用实例 token 关联网站用户，再用 API 向该 token 推送。重装、清数据或换设备会改变 token，多设备用户需保存多个。连接／原生桥接问题或方案不含推送会导致函数失败，普通浏览器访问没有应用桥接。需保密 token 并测试缺失／过期情况。本次未生成 token、通知或 API key。

sections.title_en: Browser-only login needs a deliberate return path
sections.title_zh: 仅浏览器登录需明确返回路径
sections.en: The custom-tab guide explains that some identity-provider flows reject embedded WebViews. It opens an absolute URL in a browser context, then returns data through customTabClosed; manual dismissal produces a distinct reason. Custom tabs have separate cookies and lack ordinary app-specific features, so opening login there does not automatically sign in the embedded website. The article suggests a cookie-transfer approach that requires JavaScript-readable cookies; this profile does not adopt that as a secure default. Evaluate an application-specific authenticated return path with the provider’s current requirements.
sections.zh: 自定义标签页指南解释部分身份提供方拒绝内嵌 WebView。它在浏览器上下文打开绝对 URL，再经 customTabClosed 返回数据；用户手动关闭有不同原因。标签页 cookie 独立，且无一般应用特定功能，所以打开登录不等于内嵌网站已登录。文章建议的 cookie 转移需 JavaScript 可读 cookie；本文不将其采纳为安全默认方案。需结合提供方当前要求评估应用特定认证返回路径。

sections.title_en: Price and usage depend on the localized billing view
sections.title_zh: 费用及用量取决于本地化计费视图
sections.en: The rendered annual-billing view showed SGD49/89/129 per month for Small/Medium/Large and Enterprise from SGD519, tax included. It counted monthly active devices, not unique website accounts, with caps of250/2,500/25,000. Medium/Large listed5/100 monthly dashboard broadcasts, while tooltips separately described unlimited developer-API notifications. Confirm that distinction and current regional checkout. A free design or 14-day trial does not establish sustained free distribution. Store accounts cost extra; exact store fees were not independently checked.
sections.zh: 渲染后的年付视图列 Small／Medium／Large 月均 SGD49／89／129，Enterprise 起 SGD519，含税。月活按设备而非网站唯一账户计，额度分别250／2,500／25,000。Medium／Large 列每月5／100次后台群发，提示另称开发者 API 通知不限。需确认该区别及当前地区结账。免费设计或十四天试用不能证明持续免费分发。商店账户另付费，具体商店费用未独立核对。

sections.title_en: Cancellation and refund wording matter to continuity
sections.title_zh: 取消及退款表述影响持续使用
sections.en: The Jan2024 terms provide a compiled app without a source-code transfer entitlement, require vendor-server contact for current configuration, and say subscription cancellation deactivates the app. They deny an automatic rejection refund beyond the stated withdrawal right, while the current homepage promises a refund if publishing cannot succeed. Terms also qualify future OS/store adaptations and signing-key storage. Keep those differences unresolved rather than promising permanent independent operation or guaranteed approval. Confirm applicable terms, retain signing-key backups and plan the exit before subscribing.
sections.zh: 2024年1月条款交付已编译应用，不赋予源码转移权；需联系提供方服务器获取当前配置，并称取消订阅会停用应用。条款不保证在约定撤回权以外因拒审退款，而当前首页称无法发布则退款。条款还限定未来 OS／商店适配及签名 key 保管。需保留这些差异，不能承诺永久独立运行或保证审核通过。订阅前应确认适用条款、保留签名 key 备份并规划退出。
